What this is, and what it can\'t do
Back to the 3.3.5a game and its ChromieCraft realm

One tap downloads and installs Turtle WoW\'s realm (Tortoise-WoW, its own database engine and libraries, all in one checked package), creates its own databases, and, once your client is in, makes the server\'s data from it. Everything goes in its own folder: the 3.3.5a game and its realm stay exactly as they are.

Pick your Turtle WoW 1.18.1 client: its folder (with WoW.exe and Data in it) or a zip of it. The app copies it into Turtle\'s own folder, checks every file against Turtle WoW\'s final 1.18.1 checksums as it copies, and then makes the server\'s data from it by itself.

The app can\'t download the client: Turtle WoW was shut down by a court order in 2026 that also bars distributing its client. Copy it onto the phone first (files in cloud folders can\'t be read this way). About 9 GB.
The realm needs data from your client: its DBC tables and maps (a few minutes), and vmaps for line of sight (minutes more). Pathfinding (mmaps) is optional and takes hours on a phone (Settings).
Make an account to log in with. The first one is an administrator of the realm and logs in by itself.

TortoiseBots by Sagiroth. Hire a companion from an inn\'s recruiter, or bring your own alts: they follow you, tank, heal and fight in dungeons and raids, and fill missing roles in the dungeon finder and battlegrounds. Control them with the TortoiseBotsManager addon (/tbm), which the app puts in your client. World bots start at level 1 and quest, level, travel and trade around you: more of them make the world livelier and the phone busier. Taken at the realm\'s next start.

Each version of the app names the one realm package it\'s tested with (Tortoise-WoW at a pinned commit, for the 1.18.1 client), so an incompatible realm is never put in. Newer realms come with app updates. Turtle WoW\'s client has no more updates: 1.18.1 with its 2026-04-12 hotfixes was the last.

Turtle WoW was a fan-made \"Vanilla+\" continuation of World of Warcraft 1.12. This plays it on the phone against your own local realm: Tortoise-WoW (github.com/tortoise-wow/tortoise-wow), the community restoration of Turtle WoW\'s 1.18.1 server, built for arm64 and run by the app with its own MariaDB. No internet is needed once it\'s installed.

The client is yours: Turtle WoW 1.18.1 (build 7272) with its 2026-04-12 hotfixes, the only one the realm accepts. Blizzard won its lawsuit against Turtle WoW in 2026; the court order bars distributing Turtle\'s client, so the app never downloads it.

Playerbots: TortoiseBots by Sagiroth — https://github.com/Sagiroth/TortoiseBots, with its TortoiseBotsManager addon (/tbm). Hired companions, your own alts as bots, and bots living in the world; Settings sets how many live in the world, and the rates and the starting level.

Turtle WoW lives in its own folder (files/turtle) with its own MariaDB (port 3311), databases (tw_*), world server (port 8090), Windows, accounts, saved login, settings, logs and backups. Its realm and ChromieCraft\'s share the game\'s login port (3724), so one runs at a time.
Not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment, Turtle WoW or the Tortoise-WoW project. Playing on a private server is against Blizzard\'s terms of use.

Your own copy of the Turtle WoW 1.18.1 (build 7272) client with its 2026-04-12 hotfixes, about 9 GB: pick its folder (the one with WoW.exe and Data in it), or a zip of it. Move it onto the phone first (files in cloud folders can\'t be read this way). The app copies it into Turtle\'s own folder and checks every file against Turtle WoW\'s final checksums as it copies. The world server needs dbc and maps from your client; vmaps add line of sight, and mmaps pathfinding, which creatures and bots need to move well (hours on a phone). Made on the phone with Tortoise-WoW\'s own tools; the DBC files are checked against its checksums. Adding a client makes them by itself.

Much faster than the phone, pathfinding included: on any computer with Docker and a copy of your Turtle WoW client, run scripts/make-turtle-server-data.sh from this app\'s repository (it uses the same Tortoise-WoW version as the realm on the phone). Copy the turtle-server-data.zip it makes to the phone and import it here. A zip of only mmaps adds pathfinding to the data the phone made.
